title: Pramod Suryabhan Pawar v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: Pramod Suryabhan Pawar v. State of Maharashtra, (2019) 9 SCC 608
content.holding: Distinguished between a false promise to marry made from the inception with no intention of fulfilling it (vitiating consent under misconception of fact) and a genuine breach of promise due to subsequent circumstances. This doctrinal distinction led Parliament to codify Section 69 BNS as a distinct offence.
content.relevance: Key authority demarcating Section 64 BNS rape from Section 69 BNS deceitful intercourse.
